name: Cable Anomaly Detection
description: The Cable Anomaly Detection dataset contains image-text pairs for industrial cable inspection. Each sample provides a cable image and a short instruction to detect the anomalous region, with a corresponding segmentation mask as the target output. It evaluates pixel-level anomaly localization in industrial imagery.
card_text: This dataset consists of 36 image-text samples focused on industrial cable anomaly detection. Each sample includes an input image file showing a cable or cable assembly, a natural-language prompt asking the model to detect the anomaly region, and an output mask file that marks the anomalous area at the pixel level. The modality is primarily visual with a text instruction, and the expected output is a segmentation mask aligned with the input image. The data is intended for evaluating segmentation and anomaly localization models in an industrial inspection setting, where the goal is to identify defects or irregularities on cables. The dataset is small and likely designed for few-shot or evaluation scenarios rather than large-scale training.

context.semantics: The input image depicts a cable or cable assembly under inspection. It is the visual scene that the model must analyze to identify anomalous regions.

question.semantics: A short imperative instruction telling the model to detect the anomaly region of the cable shown in the input image.

mask.semantics: A segmentation mask image that marks the anomalous region of the cable. It is spatially aligned with the input image and serves as the pixel-level target output.

meta.meta_structure_description: Each sample contains an input object with an image_file pointing to a cable image and a prompt instructing the model to detect the anomaly region. The output object contains a mask_file pointing to a segmentation mask that localizes the anomaly. The mask is aligned with the input image and provides the pixel-level annotation, while the prompt frames the visual task.
